name: Charles Seel
biography: Charles Seel (April 29, 1897 – April 19, 1980) was an American actor. He acted in over 30 films from 1938 to 1974 and appeared in over one hundred titles for television from 1952 to 1974. He was also credited as Charles Seal and Charles F. Seel.
movies: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
The Man with the Golden Arm
birthplace: The Bronx, New York City, New York, USA
